name: Cooking classes

pf.license.need: none for a cooking school or a cook in most places; where the state's form names a license or registration, the owner adds it as an optional item. Rosie checks no license, certificate, insurance or background check
pf.license.who: the business, for any registration, certificate or insurance it chooses to add
pf.license.ask: optional: any registration number, certificate or insurance the owner wants shown on the listing
pf.license.check: none: Rosie shows what the owner adds, as the owner's word, and never says it was checked
pf.license.training: a teacher's culinary training or teaching certificate is what the school says; shown as the school's word, never as a license
pf.license.background: optional: the owner may say each teacher who works with children has a background check; shown as the owner's word, never checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: a job the owner says needs a license the business doesn't have is not booked (the owner's own word, not a check)
pf.license.renewals: none: Rosie keeps no expiry clock for any item the owner adds
pf.license.insurance: optional: liability insurance the owner adds, shown as the owner's word; a host (a school, a library, a company) may ask for proof, and the owner answers it

pf.services.shape: class: a seat in a set class time by cooking, age group and level, with a set number of seats, a few trial seats and a waitlist; each learner booked is checked in on their own. Private lessons book one teacher, at the school, at a home, or by video. A class at a host's place (a school, a company office, a library) books a teacher's time for a group
pf.services.examples: the example school's own prices (Lee Kitchen and Lee Home Kitchen), not a standard

list.name: Trial cooking class (once per cook)
list.before: paid in full when booking (the school can pick instead: nothing taken, paid at the front desk)
list.after: nothing more (or at the front desk)
list.note: a parent or guardian books and signs the waiver for a child; ingredients are in the price

list.name: Kids cooking class by level (ages 8 to 12)
list.note: Little Chefs (ages 4 to 7) and pasta for kids (ages 8 to 12) are placed by age and skill; the cook OKs the level

list.name: Adult cooking class by level (18 and over)
list.note: Thai for adults and baking for teens (ages 13 to 17) are placed by the cook at the first class

list.name: Term course, 4 weeks
list.note: enrolling is the cook's own yes on the secure page, with the term's terms shown first; a term is never charged again

list.name: Private cooking lesson at the kitchen
list.note: the cook OKs each private lesson first

list.name: Adult dinner club (drop-in)
list.note: no trial needed; adults sign their own waiver; no alcohol is served or sold

list.name: Private cooking lesson at home
list.before: a card saved for the $40 fee (or paid in full when booking: the owner's pick)
list.after: the saved card charged at DONE (or nothing more)
list.note: the learner's own kitchen; groceries are bought in the price

list.name: Group cooking class at a host's place (a school, an office, a library)
list.note: with children, the host's own staff stay in the room for the whole class

list.name: Visit fee
list.length: for a lesson away from the kitchen
list.after: charged only for a late cancel or nobody home, if the owner confirms

pf.services.trial: one trial class per cook, in a class that fits the cook's age and skill; 2 trial seats per class; checked by the parent's mobile and the child's first name
pf.services.placement: a learner who already cooks at home is placed by the teacher by level, at the first lesson; a short skills check on the secure page is optional and never a booking step
pf.services.packs: no class cards or plans are sold through Rosie; the school's own bundles, if it has any, are the owner's setting
pf.services.capacity: seats per class, set by the room (10 for a group class); trial seats per class; each seat is one learner with their own check-in code; a private lesson is one teacher
pf.services.waitlist: a full class keeps a waitlist in order; a freed seat is offered by text inside text hours, to one person at a time, for 30 minutes
pf.services.minimum: a class runs only with its minimum (the owner's setting, like 4 learners), checked a set time before (like 24 hours); the owner decides
pf.services.skills: knife skills, pasta, bread, Thai and baking; menu planning; children's classes only for cooks the owner OKs for children
pf.services.online: cooking is in person only: no video classes; a demo by video is not a booking
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the learner must be there; a child's lesson at home needs a parent or guardian home the whole time

beforeTimes: who is learning: the adult themselves, or the parent's child (the age sets the class)
which cooking, and the level: never studied, some before, or a fluent speaker who wants a refresher
the goal: travel, school, work, or fun
at the school, by video, or at home
for a class at a host's place: how many learners, their ages, and the place
afterTime: anything the teacher should know, like shyness, a first class, or a need for a quiet room (on the secure page)
for a home lesson: the address, and a quiet room with a table and two chairs
for a video lesson: a laptop or tablet with a camera and microphone, in a quiet room
securePage: the parent or guardian's yes that they may book for the child, and the waiver signed for the child
the child's first name and age, any learning or health notes or allergies, and an emergency contact
the pick-up list: the adults who may take the child home
a yes or no for photos or video of the child in class
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian for anyone under 18, who books, signs and gets every text; a teen gets a link to send to a parent

stop.words: someone hurt right now: a deep cut, a bad burn or scald, fainting, a child choking, chest pain, trouble breathing

goOn.words: an injury that's healing, or a health condition
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the note goes on the secure page for the teacher; Rosie gives no health advice

goOn.words: a child who is shy or new to cooking
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the note goes to the teacher on the secure page, who keeps a trial learner close

pf.safety.children: a child is never alone with one adult behind a closed door; at a host's place, the host's staff stay in the room; any worry about a child's safety goes to Sam at once, and Sam reports it where the state's rules require
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and the child's details
steps.when: before the first lesson, signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18; adults sign their own
steps.goodFor: the term (1 year), or until the school changes it
steps.result: signed: the booking goes on; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
steps.when: on the secure page while booking; the parent can change them any time
steps.result: only adults on the list take the child home; no answer to photos counts as no

steps.name: Placement for a learner who knows some of the cooking
steps.when: at the first lesson, by the teacher
steps.result: the teacher places the learner by level; the trial books once the owner OKs it

pf.first_steps.prep: for the reminder: come 10 minutes early to check in; a notebook and a pen; for a video lesson, a quiet room, the camera on, and the link 5 minutes early; for a home lesson, a quiet table and two chairs

pf.visit.checkIn: at the school: the parent gives the child's check-in code at the desk, or the desk ticks names on the class roster; at a home: the code at the door; at a host's place: the host's contact gives the code; by video: the code is read out at the start
pf.visit.children: a child goes home only with an adult on the pick-up list; anyone else waits with staff while the parent is asked; for a first class or a child under 6, a parent stays in the building (the school's setting)
pf.visit.viewing: parents watch through the lobby window; nobody else watches a kids' class without the school's OK; photos or video of a child only with the parent's yes (a switch, on by default)
pf.visit.lateEntry: up to 10 minutes late: the learner joins after a short warm-up; later: the learner watches, and a trial moves to another day at no charge
pf.visit.changes: a teacher change is texted to every learner booked; a longer private lesson is priced and OK'd first
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or the roster tick; for a lesson away from the school, the code or DONE from the teacher
pf.visit.note: after a trial, the teacher writes a short note on the secure page: what the learner tried, how it went, and which class fits next; the parent gets a private link

pf.money.before: a trial class, a private lesson or a dinner club at the school: paid in full when booking (or a YES books it and it's paid at the desk: the owner's pick); a term course: paid in full when enrolling; a lesson at a home: a card saved, charged at DONE; a class at a host's place: paid in full when booking
pf.money.tuition: a term is paid in full when enrolling and never charged again; no monthly plan is charged through Rosie
pf.money.caps: how far ahead a term may be paid, and any deposit kept apart for money paid ahead: from the state's form
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel a class until 24 hours before; a lesson at a home until 7am on the lesson's day (the example owner's settings; the owner can set longer); a longer right to cancel from the state's form wins
pf.money.fees: a missed trial or a late cancel: the $20 may be kept only with the school's OK, and no answer in 24 hours means a full refund; a home lesson cancelled late or nobody home: the $40 fee, only if the owner confirms
pf.money.refunds: a full refund, or a new time if the learner picks one, whenever the school cancels or changes a class (a closed day, a teacher out, too few learners); never kept as a credit without a yes
pf.money.tax: no tax line, unless the owner sets one
pf.money.fee2: pays Rosfield's $2 for each confirmed booking

pf.messages.never: a child's last name, age, allergies, food restrictions or health notes, pick-up list or photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name only; texts to Sam or the staff carry no child details at all: they name the parent and the class, and link to the secure page
pf.messages.to: texts go only to the parent's phone, never to the child
pf.messages.minors: a teen under 18 gets a link to send to a parent; Rosie never texts the parent first
pf.messages.photos: photos or video of a child are shared only with the parent's yes, and never by text

pf.staff.skills: knife skills, pasta, bread, Thai and baking; menu planning; children's classes only for cooks the owner OKs for children
pf.staff.checks: any teacher's background check is the owner's word (optional, never checked by Rosie); a sub teaches a kids' class only when the owner says so
pf.staff.supervision: a child is never alone with one adult behind a closed door; two adults in the building for kids' classes (a teacher and the front desk: the school's setting)
pf.staff.ratio: up to 10 learners per teacher in a kids' class (the school's setting; a ratio from the state's form wins)
pf.staff.whoOKs: Sam places learners and OKs private lessons; Pat may OK them too
pf.staff.license: no person license for teaching cooking unless the state's form names one; the owner may add a teacher's certificate as its own word

items: selling a term ahead: any deposit, account kept apart, written contract, cancel right, or limit on how far ahead money is taken comes from the state's form
a waiver is a risk notice and consent; where the state's rules limit what a parent may sign for a child, the state's form sets the words
background checks for people who work with children: the owner's word, optional, never checked by Rosie
a worry about a child's safety: Sam reports it where the state's rules require
food safety: any food-handler card the owner adds is the owner's word, optional, never checked by Rosie
no alcohol is served, sold or booked through Rosie: a tasting hour is coffee and tea only
pf.rules.photos: photos or video of a child: only with the parent's yes (on by default)

applies: the school closes a day (a power cut, a storm, a building problem): every learner told at once, with a new time or a full refund
a teacher is out: a sub the owner OKs, and learners told
a class too small to run by its cutoff: Sam runs it, or cancels with full refunds
a full class or no trial seat left: the waitlist, or another class that fits
a learner who knows some of the cooking: the teacher places them by level at the first lesson
a child upset at a trial: sees the parent, then rejoins, with no pressure
a child hurt in class: first aid, the parent brought in, 911 if serious; an incident note to Sam on the secure page
someone not on the pick-up list: the child stays with staff while the parent is asked
arriving late: joins after a warm-up up to 10 minutes; later, watches, and a trial moves free
a question about a term's books or materials: the teacher's answer, passed on as written
pf.edges.generic: all others handled the generic way

notes:
Built from dance (refitted), not kept as it was: the dance plug-in, its words ops, plan and recital money, and its own steps were replaced; the class pattern's off ops, splits kept (A4-66, A7-15, A7-68, A8-67) and the $2 line are the same.
Facts: classes, children, waitlist, groups, video (a video lesson counts as flow A), forms. No plans, packs, photos or extra work: those steps stay hidden for this work (their gates are off).
Licenses (D96): none is needed for this work in most places; the owner may add any registration, certificate or insurance as its own word; Rosie checks none and never says it was checked. S1-60 and S2-28 license branches are off; the live master's license lines are the D96 editor's job.
sensitive is off, as in dance: a child's details stay out of texts through pf.messages (texts to a parent use the child's first name only; staff texts carry no child details).
Money (both flows): A trial $35 paid in full, or paid at the desk; the fee is $20 (the most kept on a late cancel or no-show, only with the owner's OK); B private lesson at home $150, a card saved for the $40 visit fee and charged at DONE, or paid in full when booking; group class at a host's place $150; visit fee $40; extra 30 minutes $60.
Sign-up: Sam Lee's two companies are a studio (flow A) and a home service (flow B); staff in the examples are the example business's own people; the addresses are examples.
Parent words: knife skills, pasta, bread, Thai and baking; a term is 4 weeks, $140, paid in full when enrolling; the adult dinner club is a $20 drop-in.
Allergies, food restrictions and health notes never go in a text: they stay on the secure page (pf.messages.never); the danger screen covers a deep cut, a bad burn or scald, and choking: 911 and no booking.
No alcohol is served, sold or booked through Rosie; a tasting hour is coffee and tea only. A food-handler card is the owner's word, optional, never checked.
Own step: A10-x01 (the cook's trial note by private link, with any allergy note kept on the secure page), after A10-01.
Words: 'Lee Kitchen' (flow A), 'Lee Home Kitchen' (flow B), 'Lee Home Cooking' and 'Lee Kids' Cooking'.
